item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: AFC Championship Preview, Vrabel Presser/Reaction, Team Updates
item.description: Tune in as we preview the Patriots AFC Championship against the one-seeded Denver Broncos. We talk keys to the game, matchups to watch and storylines to follow as the Patriots push for their 12th Super Bowl appearance. We listen in on Mike Vrabel's press conference and react to his statements on preparing for the Broncos, the bright lights of the AFC Championship, the team's mentality, and more. Plus, we discuss team updates on Mack Hollins and Carlton Davis.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: Broncos Preview, AP Honors Finalists, Vrabel Presser/Reactions, Championship Picks

item.title: Patriots Pregame Show: Patriots at Broncos AFC Championship Preview
item.description: Tune in as Kwani, Deuce, and Paul preview the Patriots AFC Championship matchup against the Denver Broncos. They share their key matchups and players to watch as the Patriots try to punch their ticket to Super Bowl LX! Plus, they make their predictions on stats, score and more!

item.title: Patriots Postgame Show: Full Breakdown of AFC Championship Win Over Broncos
item.description: Tune in as Kwani, Deuce, and Paul break down the Patriots 10-7 win over the Broncos in the AFC Championship. They talk good and bad takeaways, weather conditions in Denver, and more. They discuss the Patriots punching their ticket to the organization's 12th Super Bowl, and the records they set and broke to get there. item.title: 1985, Episode 9: "Berry the Bears"
item.description: Reflects on the lead-up to the Patriots' first Super Bowl, including the quirky "The Patriots and We" music video. Chronicles the game itself, where the Patriots were overwhelmed by the legendary 1985 Bears, while still honoring the season's success.

item.title: Head Coach Mike Vrabel on WEEI 1/27: "We've enjoyed this thing and we're going to continue to enjoy it"
item.description: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel joins WEEI's "The Greg Hill Show" on Tuesday, January 27, 2026. Vrabel discusses how the weather played a factor in the Patriots win over the Broncos, Drake Maye's keeper to end the game, thoughts on advancing to the Super Bowl and the continuing mindset for the team.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: AFC Championship Recap, Super Bowl Bound, Team News/Updates
item.description: Tune in as the PU crew recaps the Patriots AFC Championship win over the Denver Broncos. We talk the 10-7 victory, including its ups and downs, weather conditions, and more. We reflect on the season and what it means for the Patriots to bring the conference title back to New England after the year's historic turnaround. Plus, we talk team news, updates, and buzz coming out of championship weekend.

item.title: Drake Maye on WEEI 1/27: "I'm feeling good and ready for the Super Bowl"
item.description: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye calls in to WEEI's "The Afternoon Show" on Tuesday, January 27, 2026. Maye discusses the hard fought 10-7 win over the Denver Broncos to advance to Super Bowl LX where New England will face the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Patriots Catch-22 1/28: AFC Championship Takeaways, 3 Up/Down From Win, Super Bowl LX Preview
item.description: Tune-in as Evan and Alex break down the Patriots 10-7 win over the Broncos in the AFC Championship game. We discuss what stood out from watching then film and offer 3 up/down from the win. We offer our thoughts on Bill Belichick not getting into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2026. Plus, looking ahead to the Super Bowl LX matchup between the Patriots and the Seahawks.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: Turning the Page to Super Bowl LX, Bill Belichick Hall of Fame Snub, What to Expect during Super Bowl Week
item.description: Watch as the PU crew turn the page to look ahead the Patriots Super Bowl LX matchup against the Seattle Seahawks. We discuss the news that Bill Belichick did not make the Hall of Fame for 2026. Plus, what to expect during Super Bowl week.
